extensionDescription.message: Selectively clear site data for a specific origin

useCurrentTabShort.description: Short label of the use-current-tab button.

scopeExact.message: Only this origin. Other origins are not touched.
scopeExact.description: Scope note when cleanup is limited to the exact origin.

scopeWide.message: Cookies apply to the whole registrable domain, so related subdomains may be signed out.
scopeWide.description: Scope note when cookies are selected.

dataToClearLabel.description: Heading of the data type selection.

cookieScopeTag.description: Tag next to Cookies indicating registrable-domain scope.

confirmDataLabel.description: Confirmation label for selected data types.

confirmUntouchedLabel.description: Confirmation label for data that stays.

confirmUntouchedOrigins.message: Site storage of every other origin

confirmUntouchedBrowser.message: History, downloads, form data and passwords

confirmCookieNotice.message: Cookies are removed for the whole registrable domain, including related subdomains.
confirmCookieNotice.description: Cookie scope notice in the confirmation panel.

errorUnsupportedScheme.message: This page uses an unsupported scheme. Navigate to an HTTP(S) page.

errorSelectDataType.message: Please select at least one data type.

presetLogout.description: Name of the built-in preset that ends the login session for the target origin.

presetLogoutDesc.message: Removes this site's cookies and session storage, then reloads the tab.
presetLogoutDesc.description: Description of the Log out preset.

presetFresh.description: Name of the built-in preset that resets the site's stored state.

presetFreshDesc.message: Clears cookies and site storage for this origin, then opens its start page. The HTTP cache is kept.
presetFreshDesc.description: Description of the Fresh start preset.

presetStale.description: Name of the built-in preset that clears cached files and service workers.

presetStaleDesc.message: Clears the HTTP cache, Cache Storage and service workers, then reloads without cache. Logins stay.
presetStaleDesc.description: Description of the Fix stale files preset.

presetFull.description: Name of the built-in preset that selects every supported data type for the target origin only.

presetFullDesc.message: Selects every supported data type, for this origin only, then reloads without cache.

presetCustom.description: Label shown when the current selection no longer matches any preset.

commandCleanLast.message: Clean this origin with the last preset
commandCleanLast.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut (manifest commands) that runs the last used preset on the active tab's origin. Shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

commandCleanLogout.message: Clean this origin with the Logout preset
commandCleanLogout.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut (manifest commands) that runs the built-in Log out preset on the active tab's origin. Shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

menuCleanWithPreset.description: Title of the parent context-menu item (toolbar icon and page right-click menu). Its sub-items are the preset names.

unsupportedTitle.description: Title of the screen shown when the active tab is not an http(s) page.

unsupportedBody.message: $ARG1$ is not a web origin. The extension only works for $ARG2$ and $ARG3$ origins.
unsupportedBody.description: Explains why the tab cannot be cleaned. $1 is the tab's scheme (e.g. chrome://settings), $2 and $3 are the supported schemes (http://, https://).

unsupportedBodyProtected.message: $ARG1$ is protected by Chrome. The extension only works for $ARG2$ and $ARG3$ origins.
unsupportedBodyProtected.description: Same as unsupportedBody for protected web pages such as the Chrome Web Store. $1 is the host.

unsupportedUnknownPage.description: Fallback name of the active tab when its address is unknown.

unsupportedManualLabel.description: Label of the manual target input on the unsupported-page screen.

unsupportedPreviewLabel.description: Label above the normalized origin preview.

previewNotePathDropped.message: Path, query and hash are removed
previewNotePathDropped.description: Part of the normalization notes line.

previewNoteDefaultScheme.description: Part of the normalization notes line. $1 is the scheme, e.g. https.

previewNoteDefaultPort.description: Part of the normalization notes line. $1 is the default port, e.g. 443.

unsupportedContinueBtn.description: Button that continues with the manually entered origin.

unsupportedRecentLabel.description: Heading of the recent origins list.

relTimeJustNow.description: Relative time: less than a minute ago.

relTimeMinutes.description: Relative time in minutes. $1 is the number.

relTimeHours.description: Relative time in hours. $1 is the number.

relTimeDays.description: Relative time in days. $1 is the number.

resultDone.description: Button that closes the result screen.

resultCleanedIn.description: Result banner title. $1 is the duration in milliseconds.

resultCleanedWithErrors.description: Result banner title when something failed.

resultAfterNone.message: The tab was left as it was.
resultAfterNone.description: Banner sentence when no after-action ran.

resultAfterReload.description: Banner sentence after a normal reload.

resultAfterHard.description: Banner sentence after a hard reload.

resultAfterStart.description: Banner sentence after navigating to the start page.

resultOriginsOne.description: Banner sentence for a single origin.

resultOriginsMany.description: Banner sentence for several origins. $1 is the count.

resultMoreErrors.description: Shown when there are more errors than the one listed. $1 is the count.

resultColBefore.description: Result table header: count before cleaning.

resultColAfter.description: Result table header: count after cleaning.

resultStorageUsage.description: Result table row: bytes used by the origin.

resultKeptCookiesOne.message: 1 shared domain cookie kept on purpose ($ARG2$).
resultKeptCookiesOne.description: Footnote for kept cookies, singular. $1 is the count, $2 the domain (e.g. .example.test).

resultKeptCookiesMany.message: $ARG1$ shared domain cookies kept on purpose ($ARG2$).
resultKeptCookiesMany.description: Footnote for kept cookies, plural. $1 is the count, $2 the domain.

resultKeptCookiesNoDomainOne.message: 1 shared domain cookie kept on purpose.
resultKeptCookiesNoDomainOne.description: Footnote for kept cookies, singular, domain unknown.

resultKeptCookiesNoDomainMany.message: $ARG1$ shared domain cookies kept on purpose.
resultKeptCookiesNoDomainMany.description: Footnote for kept cookies, plural, domain unknown. $1 is the count.

resultCopySummary.description: Button that copies a short text summary of the result.

resultExportJson.description: Button that saves the report as a JSON file.

resultExportMd.description: Button that saves the report as a Markdown file.

resultCopyFailed.description: Feedback when the clipboard write failed.

resultExported.description: Screen-reader message after saving a report file. $1 is the file name.

resultExportFailed.description: Message when saving the report file failed.

optionsPageTitle.description: Document title of the options page.

optionsHeaderTitle.description: Header label next to the extension name on the options page.

optionsNavLabel.description: Accessible name of the side navigation.

optionsNavTestMode.description: Section title and navigation item. Keep the product term.

optionsLoadFailed.description: Error shown when a section fails to load.

optionsPresetsDesc.message: Combine data types and a follow-up action. A preset always runs on one target origin.

optionsImportJson.description: Button that imports presets from a JSON file.

optionsExportJson.description: Button that exports custom presets to a JSON file.

optionsExportNone.message: There are no custom presets to export.
optionsExportNone.description: Tooltip of the disabled export button.

optionsNewPreset.description: Button that opens the preset editor.

optionsPresetTableLabel.description: Accessible name of the preset table region.

optionsColAfter.description: Preset table column header: action after cleaning.

optionsAfterStartPath.description: After-action summary with the start path.

optionsBoundAny.description: Bound origin when the preset is not tied to an origin.

optionsAllTypes.description: Summary when a preset selects every data type.

optionsTypesCount.description: Summary of a preset selecting many data types.

optionsDuplicateAria.description: Accessible name of the duplicate button.

optionsEditAria.description: Accessible name of the edit button.

optionsDeleteAria.description: Accessible name of the delete button.

optionsEditorNewTitle.description: Editor dialog title for a new preset.

optionsEditorEditTitle.description: Editor dialog title for an existing preset.

optionsFieldIdHint.message: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed after saving.
optionsFieldIdHint.description: Hint under the preset ID field.

optionsFieldStartPathHint.message: Opened on the target origin, for example /cart.
optionsFieldStartPathHint.description: Hint under the start path field.

optionsFieldBoundHint.message: When set, the preset always runs on this origin.
optionsFieldBoundHint.description: Hint under the bound origin field.

optionsFieldOriginsHint.message: One exact origin per line, for example https://example.com. At most 10 in total, bound origin included.
optionsFieldOriginsHint.description: Hint under the extra origins field.

optionsFieldKeepHint.message: Cookie names separated by commas. Values are never read.

optionsIdTaken.message: A preset with this ID already exists.

optionsSaveFailed.message: The preset could not be saved.

optionsCopySuffix.description: Name given to a duplicated preset.

optionsPermissionsDesc.message: Exact cookie access is requested the first time it is needed on an origin and can be revoked at any time. The extension never asks for access to all sites.

optionsPermissionsEmpty.message: No origin has been granted access yet.
optionsPermissionsEmpty.description: Empty state of the granted origins list.

optionsRevoke.description: Button that revokes access to an origin.

optionsRevokeAria.description: Accessible name of the revoke button.

optionsRevokeFailed.message: Access could not be revoked for $ORIGIN$.

optionsInstallPermissions.description: Heading of the install-time permission list.

optionsPermBrowsingData.message: Clears site data for the origin you choose.

optionsPermActiveTab.message: Reads the address of the current tab, only when you open the extension.

optionsPermScripting.message: Clears session storage and counts items in the page you chose.

optionsPermCookies.message: Lists and removes cookies of one exact origin, after you grant access to it.

optionsPermStorage.message: Saves your presets, history and settings.

optionsTestModeDesc.message: Let Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium scripts trigger presets through a message. Pages can only clean their own origin.

optionsTestModeToggle.description: Accessible name of the Test Mode switch.

optionsAllowedOriginsHint.message: Separate with commas or new lines. An origin without a port allows any port.
optionsAllowedOriginsHint.description: Hint under the allowed origins field.

optionsTestModeNote.message: Off by default. Domain-wide cookies are not available in Test Mode.
optionsTestModeNote.description: Note under the Test Mode field.

optionsTestModeInvalid.message: Test Mode settings were not saved:
optionsTestModeInvalid.description: Heading above Test Mode validation errors.

optionsHistoryDesc.message: Keeps the last 20 cleanups on this device. No cookie values or storage contents are stored.

optionsHistoryToggle.description: Accessible name of the history switch.

optionsHistoryEmpty.description: Empty state of the history list.

optionsHistoryOff.message: History is off. New cleanups are not recorded.
optionsHistoryOff.description: Empty state when history is off.

optionsHistoryListLabel.description: Accessible name of the history list.

optionsMoreOrigins.description: Suffix when an entry covers more origins.

optionsClearHistoryConfirm.message: Delete all history entries on this device?

optionsRecentOrigins.description: Heading of the recent origins list.

optionsSessionTitle.description: Heading of the test session block.

optionsSessionDesc.message: Mark the start of a test run. The popup can then limit a cleanup to data created since then.

optionsShortcutNotSet.description: Shown when a command has no shortcut.

optionsShortcutExecuteAction.description: Fallback description of the toolbar action command.

optionsShortcutsHint.message: Change key combinations on the browser's shortcuts page:
optionsShortcutsHint.description: Hint above the shortcuts page address.

optionsOpenShortcuts.description: Button opening the browser shortcuts page.
